matrix.nominalGrid: Frequency grid only: (6.2 * FC + 30) * factor. Not a fitted reference curve.
matrix.outputLevelReason: Fixed before measurement to reduce high-harmonic PCM quantization; the voice/filter input level still comes from sustain.
matrix.harmonic: ceil(requested Hz / 3000); all fundamental registers remain in 1..65535
matrix.unmeasuredEndpoint: FC0 retains the original 30-Hz coefficient; no endpoint hardware-accuracy claim

fittingRule: Only the 7 training FCs: original coefficient Hz * reference LP/HP crossover / candidate LP/HP crossover, nearest integer, piecewise interpolation plus unchanged unmeasured FC0=30. Require positive strictly increasing valid knots below the original 16kHz stability ceiling; do not clamp/fill missing crossings. Freeze before holdout evaluation.
